outcome: Mortality rate in the first 48 hours
cohort: The study included 482 infants with gestational age 25-28 weeks born in 2007-2010 (n = 247) and 2011-2014 (n = 235) from three tertiary neonatal intensive care centers.
finding: Overall mortality among very preterm infants in Romania decreased significantly between 2007-2010 and 2011-2014 (from 65.6% to 29.4%), accompanied by reductions in early mortality and severe intraventricular hemorrhage, but increases in necrotizing enterocolitis and bronchopulmonary dysplasia among survivors.
mod_finding: Infants in the later epoch (2011-2014) were more likely to have been born by cesarean section.
followup_time: Until hospital discharge or death (for in-hospital mortality); 48 hours (for early mortality)
